changeSet.neo4j:cypher: MERGE (n0:term {value:'Pancreas, NOS',origin_id:'7670673',origin_version:'1',origin_definition:'Not characterized in any other way.: An organ behind the lower part of the stomach that is the shape of a fish and about the size of a hand. It is a compound gland composed of both exocrine and endocrine tissues. The endocrine pancreas makes insulin so that the body can use glucose (sugar) for energy. The exocrine pancreas makes enzymes that help the body digest food. Spread all over the pancreas are areas called the Islets of Langerhans. The cells in these areas each have a special purpose. The alpha cells make glucagon, which raises the level of glucose in the blood; the beta cells make insulin; the delta cells make somatostatin. There are also PP cells and D1 cells, about which little is known.',origin_name:'caDSR'}) ON CREATE SET n0._commit = '5e1fdd77f6f4f8a0f8d2c132ecfd4fe1a25bf778'

It is a compound gland composed of both exocrine and endocrine tissues. The endocrine pancreas makes insulin so that the body can use glucose (sugar) for energy. The exocrine pancreas makes enzymes that help the body digest food. Spread all over the pancreas are areas called the Islets of Langerhans. The cells in these areas each have a special purpose. The alpha cells make glucagon, which raises the level of glucose in the blood; the beta cells make insulin; the delta cells make somatostatin. changeSet.neo4j:cypher: MERGE (n0:term {value:'MERFISH',origin_id:'15156944',origin_version:'1',origin_definition:'A system that leverages the single-molecule fluorescent in situ hybridization (FISH)-based method to perform spatially-resolved single-cell transcriptome profiling for multiple genes of interest. changeSet.neo4j:cypher: MERGE (n0:term {value:'MERFISH',origin_id:'15156944',origin_version:'1',origin_definition:'A system that leverages the single-molecule fluorescent in situ hybridization (FISH)-based method to perform spatially-resolved single-cell transcriptome profiling for multiple genes of interest.
